description: The authoritative, ordered list of decision precedence levels. Evaluated strictly in this order; the first violation terminates evaluation. v2.0 adds the economics level (cost anomaly / ROI floor) between authorization and drift. A deterministic DENY remains final and cannot be overridden by a lower level.

levels.name: uaal_constraint
levels.description: Enterprise constraints — evidence-checked predicates against caller-supplied state.

levels.name: invariant
levels.description: Behavioral contracts — forbidden capability set-membership and transition constraints.

levels.name: economics
levels.description: Cost-ratio anomaly and ROI floor against caller-supplied estimates and historical baseline. Never blocks — efficiency signal, not a security violation.

levels.name: drift
levels.description: Learned behavioral drift. The ONLY non-deterministic level.

levels.name: baseline
levels.description: No violation at any prior level.

invariants: Evaluation is strictly sequential in ascending 'order'; the first level whose condition fires terminates evaluation.
Every level except 'drift' is deterministic and can only escalate or block.
A 'block' outcome at any level is final: no subsequent level can convert it to 'require_approval' or 'allow'.
'economics' and 'drift' both have outcome_on_violation 'require_approval' — neither can independently BLOCK an action; only uaal_constraint and invariant can.
